options.name: Abomination
options.benefit: Your mind is impure, tainted by outside forces.

options.name: Bleaching
options.benefit: You draw power from a void in your emotions, a yawning and empty chasm where your hopes and dreams and fears should be.

options.name: Dream
options.benefit: You discover deeper and more powerful corners of your mind through journeys you make in your dreams.

options.name: Enlightenment
options.benefit: Your quest for enlightenment has opened your eyes to new concepts and heights of spiritual awareness.

options.name: Faith
options.benefit: Your belief in a higher power fuels your psychic abilities.

options.name: Ferocity
options.benefit: You are in touch with the most primal part of your subconscious.

options.name: Hag-Called
options.benefit: A hag’s call echoes through your mind like a siren’s song, enticing you to surrender and become something horrible.

options.name: Haunted
options.benefit: You attract the attention of spirits as naturally as a lodestone attracts iron filings.

options.name: Lore
options.benefit: By collecting expert information and reading all sorts of treatises and chapbooks on occult subjects, you learn proper techniques and rituals to empower your mental abilities.

options.name: Mindtech
options.benefit: You are innately tied to and can communicate with electronic machinery and similar technological objects, through which you can funnel your psychic power like flowing water.

options.name: Pageantry
options.benefit: The act of ritual, no matter how ostentatious, can be a route to mental strength.

options.name: Pain
options.benefit: Mental blocks prevent your immense inborn psychic energies from flowing freely.

options.name: Psychedelia
options.benefit: You ingest hallucinogens to expand your mind.

options.name: Rapport
options.benefit: Forging a close bond with other people brings out the best in you, making it easier for you to link your mind with theirs.

options.name: Rebirth
options.benefit: Your mind is forged from the most powerful memories of a multitude of lifetimes.

options.name: Rivethun
options.benefit: You have embraced those aspects of your body that cause you agony, respecting the perspective they grant you if not necessarily the roles they’ve condemned you to in life.

options.name: Self-Perfection
options.benefit: You take a holistic view of psychic power, believing that you must hone both your mental and physical attributes to remain in balance.

options.name: Shadow
options.benefit: You perceive the space between light and darkness, and draw power from it.

options.name: Sorrow
options.benefit: You draw strength from deep feelings of abandonment, loneliness, and sadness, turning these emotions into a powerful weapon or a barrier that protects you.

options.name: Superiority
options.benefit: You know that you are far better than average creatures of your kind.

options.name: Symbiosis
options.benefit: Like pollen on the wind or the roots of plants in the ground, your thoughts permeate your surroundings, allowing you to study and manipulate the world around you.

options.name: Tranquility
options.benefit: Psychic magic flows through you when you attain a peaceful mental state.

options.name: Warp
options.benefit: Ratfolk mythology claims they were appointed by the gods to sniff out the ragged edges of creation.
